examples.title: Create a CheckerBoard2 node
examples.code:
# Create the node and keep a reference to it.
checkerBoard2 = nuke.createNode("CheckerBoard2")

provenance.editorial_note: Node class is present in the locked scanner dataset; Foundry toolbar source is used where the class is exposed in the standard toolbar.

examples.code:
# Configure the "boxsize" control.
checkerBoard2 = nuke.createNode("CheckerBoard2")
checkerBoard2["boxsize"].setValue(64.0, 0)
checkerBoard2["boxsize"].setValue(64.0, 1)
